body:
Date: 30 Oct 2026
Decision: Farm animals come only as a baby or an adult, no teen. A baby never grows up: it is its own animal. Babies: foal, lamb, calf, piglet, chick. Pets are not affected (they still grow baby → teen → adult).
See: https://claude.ai/artifact/6VamW3iTDycZZjZnfTrZa3#living-1

comments.text: Recorded as approved: Karolis decided it in the Living things models chat on 30 Oct.
